'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz campaign]]
****[[Operation Project Freedom]]
*****The [[United States Central Command|U.S. Central Command]] says that two [[United States Merchant Marine|US-flagged]] [[merchant ship|merchant vessels]] have passed through the [[Strait of Hormuz]], the first vessels to cross the waterway since the start of Project Freedom. Additionally, CENTCOM also says that [[United States Navy|U.S. Navy]] [[Guided-missile destroyer|guided-missile destroyers]] transited through the [[waterway]]. [https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/5862288-us-cargo-ships-strait-hormuz/ (''The Hill'')] [https://www.axios.com/2026/05/04/strait-hormuz-us-merchant-ships-cross (Axios)]
****Iranian media report that the [[Islamic Republic of Iran Navy|Iranian navy]] struck a [[U.S. Navy]] warship with two missiles, after it ignored warnings off the coast of [[Jask]]. [[United States Central Command]] denies the claim that a ship was hit. [https://aje.news/t7e6pf?update=4543540 (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/04/iran-war-trump-strait-of-hormuz.html (CNBC)]
****A fire and explosion is reported on an anchored [[HMM (company)|HMM]] vessel in the [[Strait of Hormuz]] near the [[United Arab Emirates]]. No casualties were reported. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20260504010952315?section=national/diplomacy (Yonhap)]
****A vessel belonging to [[Abu Dhabi National Oil Company]] is attacked by two drones in the Strait of Hormuz. No injuries were reported. [https://gulfnews.com/uae/iranian-drones-attack-adnoc-tanker-in-strait-of-hormuz-1.500528456 (Gulf News)]
